anomalies.observed: The DISP_SDA net, which should carry only the display I2C data line between U2 pin 35 (PB14), R7 pin 1 and the OLED data pins U4 D1/D2, also includes the Tag-Connect SWD clock pin J1 pin 4 (SWCLK) and the MCU pin U2 pin 49 (PA14), which is the SWCLK alternate function.
anomalies.expected: SWCLK (J1 pin 4 / PA14) should be a dedicated debug net, separate from the display I2C bus. DISP_SDA should connect only to PB14, R7, and the OLED D1/D2 pins.

evidence.quote: `DISP_SDA`: U2 pin 35 (`PB14`) — R7 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U4 pins 19/20 (`D1`/`D2`)

anomalies.impact: The SWD clock is shorted to the OLED SDA data line and the display bus is shared with the debugger. Debugging and programming will be corrupted or fail, the display I2C transactions will be disrupted by the SWCLK driver, and the SWD interface will not work reliably.

parsed.summary: The netlist places the Tag-Connect SWCLK pin (J1.4) and MCU pin PA14 on the display I2C data net DISP_SDA, which bridges the SWD clock to the OLED data line. The specification describes no such connection, so this is a bridged-net anomaly.
